population: 200 clips with nonzero change · 39 transitions per clip
method: Sample video at 4 frames/s and resize to 96 × 64; luma = 0.299R + 0.587G + 0.114B. Divide the largest of 39 adjacent-frame mean absolute differences by their sum. Exact-zero sums are excluded. A large jump can reflect a cut, flash or camera movement.

values.x: Largest transition’s share of sampled change (%)
